PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe postpartum return to strength after C-section"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Walking and Gentle Mobility, OB Light Activity Only" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Easy walk and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Walk and gentle mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          ankle_circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          wrist_circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          neck_roll 2x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 20m "Easy walk and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Steady walk and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk and gentle mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          ankle_circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          arm_circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          neck_roll 2x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 25m "Steady walk and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Foundations After 6-Week OB Check" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Lower body foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 45s
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper body and posture":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk and pelvic floor connection":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Lower body foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 45s
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper body and posture":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk and pelvic floor connection":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 2x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30s
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper body and posture":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 40m "Longer walk and core connection":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds

          reverse_lunge 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper body and posture":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 40m "Longer walk and core connection":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Progressive Bodyweight Strength" (6 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30s
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper body and core control":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30s
      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 45s
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30s
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper body and core control":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk and mobility":

          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds

    WEEK 9:

          squat 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
